an5.37:1.1: bhojanaṃ bhikkhave dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ pañca ṭhānāni deti.
an5.37:1.3: āyuṃ deti, vaṇṇaṃ deti, sukhaṃ deti, balaṃ deti, paṭibhānaṃ deti.
an5.37:1.4: āyuṃ kho pana datvā āyussa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassavā,
an5.37:1.8: paṭibhānaṃ datvā …pe… paṭibhāṇassa bhāgī hoti dibbassa vā mānusassa vā.
an5.37:1.9: bhojanaṃ bhikkhave dadamāno dāyako paṭiggāhakānaṃ imāni pañca ṭhānāni deti.
